summary: The non_gaia variant is a comprehensive implementation that successfully addresses all functional requirements. It features a rich set of specialized agents with concrete logic for task allocation, fair rotation (based on workload variance), and vaccination scheduling. The inclusion of a dedicated database layer ensures state persistence and data consistency across the multi-agent system.

findings.description: Excellent coverage of all requirements with specific logic.
findings.evidence: RotationAgent implements _calculate_balance_score; CalendarAgent handles overdue vaccinations.

findings.description: Robust state management via a central database utility.
findings.evidence: utils/database.py provides persistence for animals, staff, tasks, and schedules.

findings.description: Dependency on crewai library is present but agents seem to implement logic manually, which is slightly redundant.
findings.evidence: Agents inherit from crewai.Agent but override methods with custom logic.

implementation_risks: The system uses local JSON/file-based persistence (utils/database.py), which may have concurrency issues if scaled to many parallel agent processes.
